Prop extends IsLocalRing R, IsNoetherianRing R` (mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/RegularLocalRing/Defs.lean:51-53) already supplies the `[IsNoetherianRing R]` that `iff_finrank_cotangentSpace [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]` requires (Defs.lean:75); `ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight {X : Scheme} (x : X)` has no scheme hypothesis (Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Properties.lean:376) and `Subspace.dual_finrank_eq` is unconditional (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Dual/Lemmas.lean:512).

findings.issue: `finrank_zariskiTangentSpace_eq_coheight` assumes `[IsLocallyNoetherian X]`, which the proof never needs; the claim holds for a regular point on any scheme, so the hypothesis weakens the file's headline result (stalks being Noetherian does not make a scheme locally Noetherian, so this is a real restriction).

summary: The mathematics is faithful: the tangent/cotangent definitions match the standard objects, the residue-field identification at the identity is the canonical structure-morphism one, and the finrank comparisons follow from the Mathlib lemmas cited. One lemma is stated with an unnecessary hypothesis that narrows it below what its proof gives.
